title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry — Event Date Changes, Cancellation and Gift Linking Limits
content:
For each type of the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry, the following limits govern how often and how far the event date can be moved, when a registry can be cancelled, and how long a gift bought without selecting the registry can still be linked to it.

| Registry type | Event date changes allowed over the registry's life | Furthest move from the event date first registered (full calendar months, before or after) |
|---|---|---|
| Celebration Registry | 2 | 6 |
| Graduation Registry | 2 | 6 |
| Housewarming Registry | 2 | 6 |
| Baby Registry | 3 | 6 |
| Anniversary Registry | 2 | 6 |
| Wedding Registry | 3 | 12 |

| Limit | Value for every registry type |
|---|---|
| Last registry status in which the event date can still be changed | active |
| Registry statuses in which the registrant can cancel | active |
| Reactivation of a cancelled registry | not available |
| Calendar days after a guest's purchase within which an unlinked gift can still be linked | 60 |
| What is needed to link an unlinked gift | the purchase record |

**Points of judgement**

- The month limit is measured from the event date first registered, never from the latest moved date.
- The change count covers the whole life of the registry, not a period.
- *Illustration (hypothetical):* a Wedding Registry whose event date was first registered as 20 September can have its date moved to any date from 20 September of the year before to 20 September of the year after, and at most 3 times in all.
